TYPE.description: LLM provider. One of: deepseek, openai, gemini, vol, 302-ai, aliyun, openrouter, orcarouter, chatanywhere. Use the matching *_TOKEN below.

DEEPSEEK_TOKEN.description: DeepSeek API key (required when TYPE=deepseek). Get one at platform.deepseek.com.

OPENAI_TOKEN.description: OpenAI API key (required when TYPE=openai). Optional when using an OpenAI-compatible gateway via LLM_PROXY.

GEMINI_TOKEN.description: Google Gemini API key (required when TYPE=gemini).

DEFAULT_MODEL.description: Optional. Override the default model for the provider. Empty = provider default.

DB_TYPE.description: Database backend: sqlite3 (default, single container) or mysql (companion MySQL service).

DB_CONF.description: SQLite file path (DB_TYPE=sqlite3). Must sit on the /app/data volume. For mysql use a DSN: user:pass@tcp(host:3306)/db?parseTime=true

HTTP_HOST.description: HTTP listen address. :36060 for a local health endpoint, or :$(PORT) to use the Railway-injected port.

KNOWLEDGE_PATH.description: RAG knowledge base directory — drop markdown/PDF docs here; '/search <query>' searches them. On the /app/data volume.

LANG.description: Bot reply language: en, zh, ja, ko, or a 2-letter ISO code.

USE_TOOLS.description: Enable MCP function-calling / tools. true = on.

IS_STREAMING.description: Stream replies in real time. true = on.

TOKEN_PER_USER.description: Per-user rolling token budget per context window.

MAX_QA_PAIR.description: Max chat-history QA pairs retained per user.

BOT_NAME.description: Bot display name shown to users.

CHARACTER.description: Optional. A persona / system prompt that shapes every reply. Empty = neutral secretary.

MEDIA_TYPE.description: Optional. Image/video-gen provider for /photo & /video (e.g. vol, aliyun, gemini). Empty = provider default from TYPE.

LLM_PROXY.description: Optional. HTTP proxy for LLM API calls (useful when a provider endpoint is region-blocked). e.g. http://host:port

TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.description: Telegram bot token from @BotFather (enables the Telegram platform).

DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN.description: Discord bot application token (enables the Discord platform).

SLACK_BOT_TOKEN.description: Slack bot token (enables the Slack platform).

LARK_APP_ID.description: Lark / Feishu app ID (enables the Lark platform).

DING_CLIENT_ID.description: DingTalk client ID (enables the DingTalk platform).

COM_WECHAT_CORP_ID.description: Enterprise WeChat corp ID (enables the Work WeChat platform).

ALIYUN_TOKEN.description: Aliyun / DashScope API key (required when TYPE=aliyun — drives the Qwen models).
